Name: Ancient Crops - Year-Round Varieties
Author: sskerye
Description:
Ancient Crops adds four varieties you can grow outdoors in all four seasons. They survive season changes and still need regular watering.

[b]Finding and multiplying seeds[/b]
Harvest ordinary strawberries, starfruit, pumpkins or powdermelons for a chance to discover the corresponding ancient seeds. Put harvested ancient crops in a Seed Maker to grow your seed stock.

[b]Growth times[/b]
[list]
[*]Ancient Strawberry: 20 days to mature, then harvest every 5 days.[/*]
[*]Ancient Starfruit: 21 days to mature, one harvest.[/*]
[*]Ancient Pumpkin: 18 days to mature, one harvest.[/*]
[*]Ancient Powdermelon: 12 days to mature, one harvest.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Artisan goods and other uses[/b]
Turn strawberries, starfruit and powdermelons into wine, jelly or dried fruit. Turn pumpkins into juice or pickles. The finished goods have custom sprites. Ancient crops can replace their regular counterparts in recipes and share their gift preferences. They count toward shipping and Perfection by default. With Generic Mod Config Menu installed, you can exclude them from the completion requirements.

[b]Installation[/b]
Install SMAPI, extract the ZIP into your Stardew Valley Mods folder, then launch the game through SMAPI.

[b]上古作物[/b]
新增上古草莓、上古杨桃、上古南瓜和上古霜瓜。四种作物全年均可露天种植，换季不枯萎，仍需正常浇水。

收获对应的普通作物时，有机会发现上古种子。收获上古作物后，可使用种子生产器繁殖。上古草莓 20 天成熟，之后每 5 天再收获一次。上古杨桃、上古南瓜和上古霜瓜分别在 21、18、12 天成熟，均只收获一次。

上古草莓、杨桃和霜瓜可加工成果酒、果酱或果干，上古南瓜可榨汁或腌制。加工品有专属贴图。上古作物可替代对应的普通作物用于烹饪，并沿用其送礼喜好。安装通用模组配置菜单（GMCM）后，可启用“不占用完美要求”。

安装 SMAPI 后，将压缩包解压至游戏的 Mods 文件夹，再通过 SMAPI 启动。
